
[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE NOTE -- v3_combined.volt:6[/yellow bold]

GPIO 25: Also DAC channel 1. When DAC is enabled, outputs ~1.6V by default.

 [dim]5 |[/dim]     pin led = 2
 [dim]6 |[/dim]     pin buzzer: PWM = 25
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- UNSAVED STORAGE -- v3_combined.volt:11[/yellow bold]

Storage variable `boot_count` is never saved, so it resets to its default on every boot.

 [dim]10 |[/dim] 
 [dim]11 |[/dim] storage boot_count: int = 0
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Call `storage.save("boot_count", boot_count)` after changing it.[/cyan]
